 Who is Jay Puri? Meet the Indian-Origin Business Executive of NVIDIA
 By Prabhat Mishra Last Updated: Nov 12, 2026, 13:13 IST Who is Jay Puri? Meet the Indian-origin business executive of NVIDIA; his biography, education, career and NVIDIA journey in detail.
 Who is Jay Puri? Meet the Indian-Origin Business Executive of NVIDIA 
 Jay Puri is a well-known business executive in the global technology industry. He spent more than 21 years at NVIDIA, one of the world's biggest technology companies, and played an important role in managing its business across different countries. 
 His name has attracted attention in India and abroad because of his long association with NVIDIA and his work with the company's leadership team. 
 Puri joined NVIDIA in 2005 and became Executive Vice President of Worldwide Field Operations in 2009. He was responsible for the company's global sales, business partnerships, customer relations and other business activities. 
 But who is Jay Puri? Where did he study? What did he do before joining NVIDIA? Here is a look at his education, professional journey and role in the technology industry. 
 Who is Jay Puri? 
 Jay Puri, whose full name is Ajay K. Puri, is a senior business executive who worked at NVIDIA for more than two decades. 
 He joined the company in 2005 as Senior Vice President of Worldwide Sales. In 2009, he was promoted to Executive Vice President of Worldwide Field Operations. 
 In this role, he helped manage NVIDIA's business around the world. His responsibilities included sales, business development, partnerships, customer support and technical services. 
 Before joining NVIDIA, Puri worked at Sun Microsystems for 22 years. He also held positions at Texas Instruments, Hewlett-Packard and Booz Allen Hamilton. 
 His career combines engineering knowledge with business management experience.

 Jay Puri's Educational Background 
 Jay Puri has studied at three well-known educational institutions in the United States. His education includes engineering and business management. 
 Here are his educational qualifications: 
 1. University of Minnesota 
 Puri completed his Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering with high distinction from the University of Minnesota. 
 2. California Institute of Technology 
 He earned a Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering from the California Institute of Technology, also known as Caltech. 
 3. Harvard Business School 
 He also completed a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from Harvard Business School. 
 His education helped him develop knowledge of technology as well as business operations. 
 Jay Puri's Career Before Joining NVIDIA 
 Jay Puri built his career by working with several technology companies before joining NVIDIA. 
 Work at Texas Instruments and Hewlett-Packard 
 Early in his career, Puri worked in marketing, management consulting and product development. 
 He held professional positions at Texas Instruments, Hewlett-Packard and Booz Allen Hamilton. 
 These companies gave him experience in technology, marketing, product development and business management. 
 22 Years at Sun Microsystems 
 Before joining NVIDIA, Puri spent 22 years at Sun Microsystems. 
 During this period, he worked in different senior positions related to sales, marketing and general management. 
 Some of his important roles included: 
 Senior Vice President of Sun's Asia-Pacific Group. 
 Vice President of Worldwide Sales for Software and Technology. 
 President of Nihon Sun KK. 
 Vice President of Worldwide Product Marketing. 
 Jay Puri's Journey at NVIDIA 
 Jay Puri joined NVIDIA in 2005 as Senior Vice President of Worldwide Sales. 
 In 2009, he became Executive Vice President of Worldwide Field Operations. 
 He was responsible for managing several important business activities, including: 
 Global sales and business development. 
 Partnerships with other technology companies. 
 Customer relationships. 
 Solution architecture and engineering. 
 Programme management. 
 Customer support services. 
 Why is Jay Puri Important to NVIDIA? 
 NVIDIA is known around the world for its computer chips and artificial intelligence technology. 
 Its graphics processing units (GPUs) are used in gaming computers, data centres, scientific research and AI systems. 
 However, running a global technology business also requires strong sales networks, business partnerships and customer relationships. 
 Jay Puri was responsible for many of these activities during his time at NVIDIA. 
 He worked with customers and business partners across different countries and helped manage the company's worldwide operations. 
 His long association with NVIDIA made him an important part of its business leadership. 
 Jay Puri's Retirement from NVIDIA in 2026 
 Jay Puri's retirement from his executive position became effective on August 24, 2026. 
 According to NVIDIA's official filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), he informed the company in June 2026 that he planned to retire. 
 NVIDIA also stated that Puri was expected to continue as a senior adviser to help with the transition. 
 Nick Parker joined NVIDIA on August 24, 2026, as Executive Vice President of Worldwide Field Operations, taking over Puri's former position. 
 Parker previously worked at Microsoft for 26 years and held several senior business positions there.

 Who is the CEO of NVIDIA? 
 Jensen Huang is the co-founder, President and CEO of NVIDIA . 
 He founded the company in 1993 along with Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem. 
 Under his leadership, NVIDIA became a major company in the global graphics and artificial intelligence industries. 
 Jay Puri worked as one of NVIDIA's senior business executives for more than two decades, but the company has not officially announced him as Huang's successor.
